title: Underlying abelian acyclicity of injective module-valued etale sheaves
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and $\Lambda$ a commutative ring. If $G$ is injective in the category of $\Lambda$-module valued sheaves on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], let $SG$ be its underlying abelian sheaf. Then $R^{n+1}\Gamma(Y,SG)=0$ for every $n\geq0$, with global sections and cohomology as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. No injectivity of $SG$, compactness of $Y$, or flatness of $\Lambda$ is assumed.

proof.text: Apply moduleSheaf_constantRing_equivalence to obtain an equivalence e from ModuleCat-valued etale sheaves to modules over the underlying ring sheaf of the constant commutative-ring sheaf, together with its underlying-abelian natural isomorphism eAb. Set I=e(G). Mathlib Equivalence.map_injective_iff preserves injectivity, so I is injective.

Set J to the precoverage of the small etale topology. Prove J.toGrothendieck equals the original topology, using toGrothendieck_toPrecoverage_le and generate_mem_toGrothendieck on each covering sieve. For every covering family choose a SiteCechComplex S. Apply injective_module_cech_cohomology_isZero to I, rewriting the topology with this equality. Use nonempty_etale_siteCech_complex_iso and map its inverse through the homology functor to transport zero positive cohomology to the categorical cechComplexFunctor.

Apply isZero_rightDerived_etale_of_cech_vanishing with B=Set.univ and Cov equal to membership of the generated sieve in the small etale topology. Covering and closure hypotheses are immediate; every cover refines itself by identity maps. Supply the preceding Cech vanishing and evaluate at the terminal object in degree n+1.

Mathlib Sheaf.ΓNatIsoSheafSections identifies global sections with terminal evaluation. Transport additivity along this isomorphism. Derive its hom and inv using NatTrans.rightDerived; rightDerived_comp and rightDerived_id prove the inverse identities. Transport the derived evaluation vanishing along its component, then along rightDerived.mapIso applied to the inverse of eAb.app G. This gives exactly the stated underlying-abelian global sections vanishing.
